title: Base Role Taxonomy
description: A top-down inventory of substantive, rhetorical, communicative, information-bearing, and structural roles for one document format.

format.description: The exact document-format label for which the role inventory was proposed.

roles.description: A non-empty inventory of distinct primary functional roles.

name.description: A unique one-to-three-word functional role name in Title Case.

definition.description: One sentence defining the content or bounded component labelled by the role and its primary function.

assignment_test.description: One sentence stating when this role should be selected as an outline item's single primary role.

distinguished_from.description: One sentence identifying the nearest competing role or roles and the decisive functional distinction.
